about: The farmland's vendor trees and bushes (w4a-farmland-vegetation, D-088, D-089): an asset id per source family, each variant named as the prefab the farmland's terrain places, so the map export's variant ids are these. Params: assets-src/<class>/<variant>.json; built by python tools/blender/vendor_plants.py; nothing of their meshes is pushed.

VF01.family: Poly Haven island_tree_01 (CC0), reduced to cards by the friend's build_island_tree.py

VF02.family: Book of the Dead Pine_002 (Unity Asset Store)

VF03.family: Book of the Dead pine_004 (Unity Asset Store)

VF04.family: Book of the Dead pine_006 (Unity Asset Store)

VF05.family: Book of the Dead PineDead_02 (Unity Asset Store)

VF06.family: Book of the Dead's Megascans Bush_b, the dead bush (Unity Asset Store)

VF07.family: Book of the Dead's Quixel GreenBush (Unity Asset Store)

VF08.family: Book of the Dead's Megascans Bush_qilgP2, the leafy bush (Unity Asset Store)

VF09.family: Book of the Dead's Quixel RedBush (Unity Asset Store)

VF10.family: Unity Terrain Sample BushDry_A and _B (Unity Asset Store)
